observation.command: cd /workspace && pkill -f "next dev"; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 3; rm -f /tmp/dev3.log; nohup yarn dev > /tmp/dev3.log 2>&1 & echo "pid $!"; sleep 18; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/root.html -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 90 "http://localhost:3000/"); echo "root -> $code ($(wc -c </tmp/root.html) bytes)"; echo "--- title/content ---"; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/root.html | head; grep -oiE 'klimadashboard|münster|photovoltaik|wind|co2' /tmp/root.html | sort | uniq -c | head
